promptCache: explicit identical-prefix KV cache only, separate identity and learning slots; every request supplies its complete two-message context and no conversation history
stopping: fixed corpus and seeds sealed before first campaign response; no retries, threshold tuning, sample exclusion or model substitution
learning: LLM authors typed rules using structured visible training arithmetic. Only identifiable candidates matching training examples enter durable knowledge. Prompts retrieve only rules named by the task and compile unevaluated Python assignments with unchanged input literals. The compiler never executes them. The wire presents that program directly with training feedback only when learning; exact request messages are journaled and reconstructed by the verifier. The LLM supplies each working variable and its final raw answer and confidence. No computed value controls the response schema and correct working values never replace a wrong final answer. The same 970 main inference calls and all original caps remain. Rejected proposals remain audited and contradictory feedback revokes knowledge.
identity: Causal registry recognition context verifies sealed ancestors and episode provenance. An immutable birth anchor validates personal origin updates and bad raw answers remain errors. Birth information is supplied until the first valid personal copy. Later prompts use the validated LLM authored self memory.
transformations: real registry changes of name role revision plus alternate cognitive instructions and memory presentation, fixed model weights
restart: fresh OS process every 50 training cycles and every feedback-free held-out window; native offline LLM server is killed and reloaded before each heldout window; no conversational history
controls: frozen empty lessons and equally sourced lessons permuted within family, paired on each held-out task; unknown operations not taught
analysis: per-lineage operational identity rates with Wilson lower bound z=2.78; paired Hoeffding gain bounds by task and family; all lineages must pass; no inference across model populations
scope: One local model trajectory with verified runtime recognition context and validated LLM authored rule memory. Same300 transformations and970 primary inference calls and unchanged v1 criteria. No unassisted LLM or psychological identity claim.
